question.text: CALENDAR rebalancing (quarterly) vs THRESHOLD rebalancing (±5%) — key trade-off:

answer.text: Calendar = higher turnover / stale; Threshold = efficient but requires monitoring

explanation.text: The Logic: Calendar is simple but can be mistimed; threshold is efficient (rebalances only when material) but needs daily monitoring. The Trap: No one-size-fits-all. Cross-Exam Context: Standard. Manager's Pro-Tip: Most institutions use HYBRID: calendar (quarterly) + threshold (±5-10% drift) — best of both.
